name: enterprise-mcp-baseline
description: Review baseline for PromptSonar MCP audit findings before approving Claude/Cursor/local MCP configs.

requiredActions.MCP-001: Block unencrypted, raw-IP, or unsafe local endpoints until the publisher, transport, and auth model are documented.
requiredActions.MCP-002: Require least-privilege scoping for filesystem, shell, admin, and network capabilities.
requiredActions.MCP-003: Require explicit authentication indicators for remote MCP servers.
requiredActions.MCP-004: Manually review tool descriptions containing directive-like or prompt-injection text.
requiredActions.MCP-005: Remove hardcoded secrets, rotate exposed credentials, and use managed environment variables.
requiredActions.MCP-006: Document domain ownership and trust rationale before approving unknown remote domains.
requiredActions.MCP-007: Normalize legacy or malformed configs before production use.
requiredActions.MCP-008: Block broad write/delete filesystem scope until paths and operations are explicitly constrained.
requiredActions.MCP-009: Remove host credential passthrough such as SSH agent sockets, cloud credentials, Docker host, or Kubernetes config.
requiredActions.MCP-010: Pin package versions, container digests, or commit SHAs before approving MCP server startup commands.

evidenceRequired: Rationale for every accepted medium or low finding
Credential rotation ticket for every MCP-005 finding
Scope review for every MCP-008 or MCP-009 finding
Pinned package/version evidence for every MCP-010 finding
